listModels.title: List models
listModels.description: Lists the models currently available through aio-proxy.
listModels.note: Agent negotiation and client_version catalogs are excluded from this page.

createChatCompletion.title: Create a chat completion
createChatCompletion.description: Creates an OpenAI-compatible chat completion. Set `stream: true` to receive a streaming response. Requests are parsed against this endpoint's schema. A same-protocol provider with raw capability receives the raw-forwarded request after routing rewrites; cross-protocol and AI SDK providers receive a converted model request, so fields that cannot be represented by the target protocol are not forwarded.
